title: OpenRoads workflows and connector status
description: Explore OpenRoads workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Bentley Systems

OpenRoads

OpenRoads Designer supports survey, roadway geometry, drainage and civil deliverables in a model-based environment.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Create a terrain model

Start from the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended OpenRoads preview, create a terrain model; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Develop corridor geometry

Begin with the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended OpenRoads preview, develop corridor geometry; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Review drainage and quantities

Use the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended OpenRoads preview, review drainage and quantities; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
